analysis.overall: A strong day with 90% time in range and a low average of 124 mg/dL, though a late-night spike required aggressive corrections that caused a rapid overnight fall.

events.title: Late afternoon return to range
events.description: After hovering around 198 mg/dL, meal insulin and small corrections brought glucose down smoothly into the 110s by 5:30 PM.

events.title: Late-night spike
events.description: Glucose climbed steadily up to 239 mg/dL, prompting multiple close correction doses over an hour.

events.title: Steep overnight drop
events.description: The accumulated correction insulin took effect quickly, driving glucose down from 239 mg/dL to 81 mg/dL where it safely flattened out.

events.title: Waking up near low boundary
events.description: Glucose drifted down to 71 mg/dL in the early morning before minor corrections lifted it safely back around 100 mg/dL.

events.title: Breakfast peak and recovery
events.description: A 50g carb meal created a controlled rise up to 161 mg/dL around 11:30 AM, returning smoothly to 105 mg/dL by early afternoon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be cautious when giving multiple small correction boluses close together late at night, as they can combine into a very steep drop during sleep.
